summary: Kustom Entertainment filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-5 reverse stock split and corresponding reduction in authorized shares from 66,666,666 to 13,333,333, effective April 22, 2026. Outstanding shares were reduced from 2,633,063 to 526,613. The split was approved by the board and filed with the Nevada Secretary of State; fractional shares will be rounded up. No shareholder vote, premium, or third-party consideration is involved. This is a routine corporate action to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a special situation. What to watch: potential for reverse-split-related volatility and continued listing eligibility.
